_doc: Static known-good corpus (precision PR 2). Top PyPI + npm packages by downloads, pinned to one version with the archive production scans (PyPI: a wheel first, the sdist only when no wheel fits; for an sdist, the wheel whose member list is the installed surface). Archives are downloaded into a cache, verified by sha256, and NEVER executed or installed. Default expectation: no package is 'do_not_connect'. `expect` (safe|review) is recorded only after a human read the reason. Rebuild with scripts/corpus/build_manifest.py; run with scripts/corpus/run_static_corpus.py.
